_meta.description: Map generation rules per trail difficulty. Single starting point, branches and reconnections, single destination. All paths lead to the final node. Harder branches offer better rewards but more risk. FTL/StS-style galactic map — visually distinct per trail.
_meta.visual_note: Lunar maps are blue-gray and close, rocky. Mars maps are warm amber, dusty. Interstellar maps are deep indigo to black with distant stars. The visual should tell you the difficulty before you read a label.
_meta.repeat_cooldown_note: Ruling 65: trails.*.repeat_cooldown_stops — a repeatable event (once: false) drawn at one stop stays out of that trail's pool for the next N stops. A stop where every eligible event is cooling down still draws: the least recently drawn. An event SCAN already locked in still fires.
_meta.supply_cost_note: Ruling 68: trails.*.event_supply_cost_mult — {water, food} multipliers on what an event outcome costs in water and food (negative deltas only; gains, the daily draw, purchases, a fight's own tally and a resources_pct share are untouched). Applied once in the engine (eventSupplyCost via effectiveResDelta), so every preview shows the scaled number. 1 = as authored. Ruling 69: Mars also starts short of water and food (starting_resources 70, the tanks still hold 100).
_meta.oxygen_fuel_note: Ruling 97: trails.*.travel_fuel_budget is the fuel the path burns at RIDICULOUS (55 before, on every trail); o2_per_day is the crew's daily breathing before the healthy crop's and the recycler's share.

late_difficulty.notes: Ruling 58: past from_progress (legs flown over the path's legs) the difficulty weights move in a straight line from event_difficulty_weights to weights_at_arrival at the destination. Re-weights eligible events only; pity relief suspends it. ultra stays 0 here: the ultra tier is interstellar's late legs only.

pity_counter.description: After 4 consecutive events tagged difficulty: hard or ultra, the engine temporarily weights toward easy/medium for the next 2 events.
pity_counter.notes: Pure engine logic. Not encoded in module tags. Prevents death spirals.
